candidates.summary: The whole routine rewritten: whole rows unrolled 8 ORA/DEY a pass (clean exit one taken BEQ), part rows as seven LDA/BNE/DEY slots entered by a once-a-row self-modified BRA, and the row counter kept in X (no STX/LDX sky_q, 6 cycles a row; ORA #0 instead of TAX, X untouched by the part path); dirty falls through from the whole path.
candidates.equivalence: Replaces the whole routine. Row loop: the original keeps the row in X only across sky_row, saving it in sky_q (STX/LDX 6 cycles a row); here X is never written inside the row (sky_row reads X and leaves it; the whole path used TAX only to set Z, now ORA #0 sets it from A; the part path no longer uses X), so INX/CPX run on it directly and sky_q is not stored (its only other users, sky_draw and sky_zero in sky_main.6502, store it fresh in their own row loops before reading it). Whole path (JSR sky_row then Z set: sky_skip = 0, rn = 8, hence rt = 7 and sky_ry a multiple of 8, so Y = 8k + 7, k <= 13): the OR loop is eight ORA/DEY a pass, k+1 passes, ending Y = -1 with A = the same OR as the original, in the same byte order; ORA #0 gives Z from A (as TAX did); BEQ next_row when clean (original TAX/BNE/BRA), else falls into dirty (SEC, RTS: the same exit, now placed after the branch; the original BNE dirty). Part path (Z clear: sky_skip = 8 - rn is 1..7, n = rn): see candidate "part rows": the five-byte slots LDA (s_ptr),Y / BNE dirty / DEY are the original line body; the BRA offset 5 * (skip - 1) enters at the slot that leaves n of them; SBC #4 with C clear gives 5 * skip - 5 and no borrow so C = 1; the step TYA/SBC sky_skip/TAY/BPL as before without the SEC (C = 1 whenever the loop continues: a borrow gives a result of at least 249, negative, which leaves); X, Y, A, C at next_row/dirty as before (the caller reads only C). Falling out reaches next_row, which now INXs X directly. Exit CLC/RTS and dirty SEC/RTS unchanged.
candidates.relies_on: Measured on a scratch copy of the tree, bench build (DEBUG_LIVES, unshifted), pcprof work a pass: control 34422.4 (seed 1, 1500 passes) / 39622.9 (RIGHT held from 50, 600 passes); passlock against the control, 3000 passes seed 1 --screen --unclobber: state and screen identical every pass. This candidate: 34327.8 / 39610.2, saves 94.6 / 12.7 a pass. Relies on: sky_row never writing X (it only reads sky_rl,X .. sky_ry,X); sky_q read nowhere after sky_check returns (sky_draw and sky_zero store it in their own row loops before reading it; the byte &E0 is no longer written here); Y = 8k+7 (k <= 13) on Z-set entries (sky_rt | sky_ry); sky_skip in 1..7 on the part path; the BRA operand at ckp_br + 1 written once a row before its BRA runs, from bank 4 sideways RAM (writable: render.6502 already stores to code operands, dst1 + 2, hud_r1 + 2), the routine not re-entered and not run by an interrupt. Code size +53 (49 -> 102 bytes, the bench listing: render_end &A366 -> &A39B): everything after sky_check in bank 4 (sky_blk_lo/hi, render_end, sprite_column_count, the ck tables, straight_sprite_lo/hi and the sprites) moves up 53 bytes, so their indexed table reads and the sprites' (zp),Y reads change page crossings in ways I did not count (the measurement above includes them: net gain 94.6). The routine itself stays inside page &A3 in the bench build; BNE row is 97 back, the farthest.

candidates.equivalence: Reached only by BNE cell not taken after JSR sky_row, i.e. Z set, i.e. sky_skip = 0, i.e. sky_rn = 8. Every entry with rn = 8 has sky_rt = 7 (the bottom row only when L = 7; the middle and top rows are stored with rt = 7; the cross entry copies rt and rn) and sky_ry a multiple of 8 (ytop = 8 * (d2 - d1); the cross entry 0 - sky_rl - 8 and ytop - sky_rc, sky_rl and sky_rc multiples of 8: sky_rl = 8 * d1 + (A and F8) - 8, minus &80 for the rows above), so Y = ry | rt = 8k + 7, and k <= 13 (an image block is 112 bytes). The original ORs bytes Y, Y-1 .. 0 and leaves Y = -1, A = their OR. The unrolled loop does eight ORA/DEY a pass and tests Y after the eighth, so from Y = 8k+7 it makes exactly k+1 passes (Y = 8j-1 after j.. the BPL sees Y >= 0 until the last), reads the same bytes in the same order, and leaves Y = -1, A = the same OR, N set by the last DEY as before. After the loop: TAX sets Z from A as before; BEQ next_row is taken when A = 0 (original: BNE dirty not taken, BRA next_row) and BRA dirty when not (original: BNE dirty taken); same two targets, same registers (nothing live in X, Y or A at either label: next_row reloads X from sky_q, the caller does not read Y or A after sky_check returns C; C is set by CLC/SEC). Page crossings of the (s_ptr),Y reads are the same reads.

candidates.summary: Part character rows only (sky_skip 1..7): the per-line LDX / LDA / BNE / DEY / DEX / BNE loop becomes seven LDA/BNE dirty/DEY slots entered by a once-a-row self-modified BRA offset 5 * (skip - 1); the SEC before the step is dropped (C is set whenever the loop continues). Independent of the whole-row candidate (different lines); an alternative to the full rewrite.
candidates.equivalence: Reached only by BNE cell taken after JSR sky_row, Z clear: sky_skip = 8 - sky_rn is 1..7 (rn is 1..8: the bottom row L+1, middle rows 8, top 1..8; never 0), so n = 8 - skip is 1..7. Setup: A = skip; ASL ASL (skip <= 7, C stays clear); ADC skip (sum <= 35, C clear on exit); SBC #4 with C clear subtracts 5: A = 5 * (skip - 1) >= 0 with no borrow, so C = 1; stored as the BRA operand, which enters the ladder at slot skip-1 (slots are 5 bytes), leaving 7 - (skip - 1) = n slots. Each slot is the original line body (LDA (s_ptr),Y / BNE dirty / DEY) so the n lines are read in the same order with the same early exit; the original LDX sky_n / DEX / BNE line count is the number of slots entered. Then TYA, SBC sky_skip, TAY, BPL as before, without the SEC: C is 1 on entry, the slots do not touch C, and after an SBC C is 1 unless Y < skip, which gives a result >= 249 (negative) and leaves the loop through BPL, so whenever the loop goes round again C = 1 (Y is either 0..127, or &FF = -1 after the bottom cell, where &FF - skip has no borrow and is negative). BPL ckp_br goes back to the BRA (operand unchanged: skip is the same for the whole row) instead of to the LDX sky_n; falling out reaches next_row as before, with X unused here (next_row reloads it). V changes as in the original (SBC); A, Y, C at next_row/dirty are dead as before. sky_n is now written by sky_row but not read here (no other reader of it in the window; sky_row is outside).

This candidate alone: 34383.8 / 39614.8, saves 38.6 / 8.1 a pass (with the whole-row candidate: 91.4 / 11.5). The BRA operand at ckp_br + 1 is stored once a row before its first execution; the routine runs from bank 4 sideways RAM (writable), is not re-entered, and no interrupt runs it. sky_skip is in 1..7 on this path. Code size +37: everything after sky_check in bank 4 moves up 37 bytes (page crossings of what follows are in the measurement, not counted by hand). The routine stays inside page &A3 in the bench build (BRA entry costs no page-cross cycle) and every branch is in range.
